offering_description.value: Supplies home medical equipment and recurring supplies to patients with sleep apnea, respiratory conditions, diabetes, and other home care needs. It sources equipment from manufacturers and works with prescribers and health plans to arrange delivery, setup, and resupply.

primary_products.value: Positive airway pressure devices and supplies; home oxygen equipment and ventilators; glucose monitors and insulin pumps; hospital beds and mobility aids; enteral feeding and incontinence supplies

primary_services.value: Home equipment rental and setup; respiratory therapy; equipment-use monitoring; recurring supply fulfillment

customer_segment.value: B2C: Patients managing sleep apnea, respiratory disease, diabetes, or other conditions at home; B2B: Health plans that contract for home medical equipment and supplies for their members

end_markets.value: Home medical equipment; sleep apnea care; respiratory care; diabetes management; home recovery and long-term care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurers pay for covered equipment, rentals, and supplies; product sales: Outright purchases of equipment and consumable supplies; rental or leasing: Recurring rental charges for eligible home medical equipment
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; product sales; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Sources medical devices and consumables from manufacturers and supplies them to patients; service provider: Uses prescriptions and referrals to coordinate home equipment delivery, setup, monitoring, and resupply

geography_served.value: US national: Patients served across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Sleep therapy, respiratory care, diabetes management, and general home medical equipment and supplies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Patient intake, fulfillment, and home delivery teams; own locations: Local branches that dispense and service home medical equipment; partners / resellers: Referrals from hospitals, sleep clinics, physician practices, and other care providers; online: Patient portals and online tools for ordering replacement supplies
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Home medical equipment suppliers face CMS accreditation and enrollment requirements, state licensing rules, and HIPAA privacy obligations.

divestiture_lines: P1.41: AdaptHealth Corp. Enters into Definitive Agreement to Divest Diabetes Health Business to Cardinal Health
